data.name: Earthly Biochar
data.description: Earthly Biochar is a small UK biochar producer founded in 2018 that sells EBC-certified biochar made from waste wood and manufactures purpose-built smokeless top-lit-updraft kilns for gardeners and land managers. A sister entity, Earthly Biochar Industries Ltd (2023), targets business customers and plans a larger UK pyrolysis facility. Both Companies House entities remain Active with filings through 2024.
